messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC-8421 — elevated 5xx rate on inference-gateway (region-us-west). Trigger: gateway 502 spike, >40% error rate over 1m. @alex_oncall paged.

alex_oncall: Ack. Jumping in. any immediate customer reports?

sre_jordan: Seeing surge of 502/504, backend model-runner processes crashing with SIGSEGV and OOM logs. Metrics: error rate peaked 47% at 13:12 UTC.

eng_runtime_kim: On it. Pulling logs from pod: `kubectl -n infer logs model-runner-42 -c runtime`

eng_runtime_kim: log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T13:11:35Z model-runner[pid=2345]: kvcache resize -> mem+ 1.2GB
2026-03-17T13:11:36Z model-runner[pid=2345]: alloc failed: OutOfMemoryError
2026-03-17T13:11:36Z model-runner[pid=2345]: Fatal: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f8b2c...
 backtrace: model_runner::serve+0x1f3, attention_kernel::compute+0x4a
```

eng_runtime_kim: multiple pods show same pattern, kswapd / kernel OOM messages on node. Likely memory amplification from large-batch requests + KV cache growth.

alex_oncall: Can we fallback traffic to smaller model variant? product_lina: we have a compatible 4GB-quant variant in catalog that is functionally equivalent for most customers.

ops_ben: I can flip routing rule on the gateway. Plan: 1) scale up model-runner pool + cordon affected node, 2) enable fallback routing to quant-4gb variant for current traffic, 3) restart crashed pods.

alex_oncall: Do step 2 first. We need to reduce immediate error surface.

ops_ben: Executing rollout: `gatewayctl route set inference -> model:quant-4gb, weight:80%`

ops_ben: :white_check_mark: Route change pushed. Monitoring.

eng_runtime_kim: Restarting model-runner pods on nodes with OOMs: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-runner`

eng_runtime_kim: Also setting KV cache upper bound for this model to 512MB to avoid uncontrolled growth. Patch applied: `runtime-config set model.kv_cache.max_bytes=536870912`

alex_oncall: Good. Observability? any drop in 5xx?

sre_jordan: Error rate fell to 6% within 90s of routing change, down to <1% after scaling and restarts. No new SIGSEGVs after kvcache cap.

product_lina: Customer impact — preliminary: ~12 minutes of elevated errors, estimated 4.8% of requests during window failed. Affected: 3 small trial orgs and 1 paid enterprise (eu-west region) with <1% of their calls impacted due to fallback behaviors.

alex_oncall: Noted. Coordinating with CS for outreach to the enterprise. assign postmortem.

eng_runtime_kim: Quick cause hypothesis: large-batch requests interacting with brand-new attention kernel path + unbounded KV cache growth on long-running sessions -> OOM -> crash. Need regression testing on kernel with memory pressure.

ops_ben: Temporary mitigation checklist posted in incident-runbook: drain problematic node, cap kvcache, scale model-runner + fallback routing.

alex_oncall: Handoff to SRE for full post-incident follow-up. @sre_jordan you'll own the postmortem?

sre_jordan: I’ll take it. Creating INC-8421-POSTMORTEM and assigning to eng-runtime for root cause.

product_lina: We'll draft customer comms template and wait for postmortem details.

eng_runtime_kim: Immediate next actions we’ll take: 1) add unit/regression test for attention kernel under kvcache pressure, 2) add OOM detector alert on nodes (node_memory.available threshold), 3) add auto-fallback policy in gateway for sustained 5xx > 5% for 1m.

alex_oncall: Thanks all. Current status: mitigated, monitoring stable. Closing the live incident channel in 30m unless regression. :thumbsup:
